snippet.title: Silver Palace Gameplay Showcase
snippet.description:
The world lingers in the past, mysteries loom in the future. But today is yours to shape.
Head into the city—take it slow or charge ahead, audience with Her Majesty or recruit your own maid. The era rests in your grasp.
 
Come on, Detective. Let us journey to the Silver Palace.

▶ Pre-register now: https://silverpalace.elementagames.com/en-us
 
*The game is still in development, and the current build does not represent the final quality. Please note that this gameplay video was recorded with Simplified Chinese setting. Thank you for your understanding.
 
 #SilverPalace
